english.title: Use a ticket for a longer journey with intent to avoid payment for a shorter journey on the Croydon Tramlink system
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) on the Croydon Tramlink system used a ticket for a longer journey, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LONGER JOURNEY..), with intent to avoid payment of the fare for a shorter journey, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SHORTER JOURNEY..), where the fare for that shorter journey was more than the fare for that longer journey
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 20 and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
